sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraud following an undocumented coordinated pattern on card C05061-K1 held by customer C05061 (internal case AC-HHF-001, opened 2017-01-15). Between 2017-01-12 and 2017-01-14 the card was used for 3 transaction(s) totalling $2,189.02: on 2017-01-12 $850.28 online in billing region 492.0; on 2017-01-13 $890.79 online in billing region 264.0; on 2017-01-14 $447.95 online in billing region 492.0. The activity matches a coordinated undocumented wave across 14 cards sharing the signature (ProductCD='C' + DeviceType='mobile' + device_new='New' + IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS + spoofed OS/UA wave). The other connected cards in this wave are C00450-K1, C02342-K1, C05704-K2, C05770-K1, C06220-K1, C06962-K2, C07212-K2, C07925-K1, C07997-K1, C09251-K1, C10553-K1, C11309-K1, C11543-K2. The activity was identified from the bank's graph of shared devices and prior cases rather than from a customer report. The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history (prior median purchase $134.93). No prior report has been filed on this customer. OFAC SDN screening of the customer identifier: no match (anonymised identifiers; screening result recorded from the sdn.csv lookup in the live run). Recommended actions: a block and reissue of the card, not yet done and awaiting team-lead approval, internal case opened, 13 connected cards placed under monitoring, case escalated to an analyst.
